## Notes

- **Job description and write paths.** `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name` with `=`) / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` (`--stateless --no-skip-pr-referenced` after the seat strips the state label and assignee; it refuses an owned card) and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (ops: `issue_patch`, `pr_request_reviewers`, `pr_ready`, `automerge_enable`; no close op exists); a body refresh needs `--ack-through=ID` from the LAST comment page. Route: `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`); the same objectstack relay serves `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui`.
- **Landing.** Tier H = an authorized APPROVED review, then the seat clears `needs-user-decision` and lands (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`), unless the approver already did; Tier S (`.claude/**`) = at-tier review PASS then the seat lands; non-governed (`scripts/pm/**`) = CI + the seat's at-tier read, through the queue; the enqueue reading is `check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0 plus `check-governed-merges --pr N`. Direct acceptance (draft PR present + CI all green + the subagent confirmed dead + no report) is legitimate with the criteria unreduced. A ratcheted `.claude/**` file is paid in place by deleting a restated line whose owning copy stays on the reading path.
- **Platform readings (inherited + this shift):** the shell's working directory resets between tool calls (`git -C` / absolute paths); a four-stroke relay batch exceeds a 120 s foreground tool call; the 5-hour usage wall terminates in-flight dev subagents and restarts the worker (the wall message carries the reset time; the Routine survives; recovery = direct acceptance or SendMessage resume per 〈断粮与跨墙恢复〉); `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` held the verify lock 1216–1246 s per run when routed through it; since PR #21798 the dev rule names it as an unlocked, detached `check:*` gate. New this seating: `git-history.mjs touch` takes `--path=FILE` (a bare `--` is a usage error) and deepens a shallow clone by itself (50 → 1753 commits); the container's `gh` CLI reports its token invalid while the same token answers REST through the proxy (core 15000) — read with `curl`, never `gh`; `check-expected-skips.mjs` imports `yaml`, so the shared checkout needs one `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (6.9 s on a warm store, zero tracked paths touched) before the enqueue pre-check can run; a fresh checkout has none.
